permit.applies: The employer lodges the application with the Work Permit Board on the worker's behalf (Immigration Regulations reg. 44(2)).
permit.first: A Labour Clearance from the Commissioner, after the post is advertised in two consecutive issues of an Islands newspaper and no suitable Islander applies (Ordinance s. 35; reg. 44(5), 45).

fees.what: Non-refundable administrative fee (or 10% of the annual work permit fee, whichever is greater)
Temporary Work Permit (up to ten days)
Per band member, groups performing at commercial events

permit.eligibility: the person in respect of whom the work permit is sought is proficient in written and spoken English

sources.title: Immigration Ordinance Cap. 5.01 and Subsidiary Legislation, Revised Edition showing the law as at 31 March 2021 (Law Revision Commissioner; hosted by the TCI Financial Services Commission): s. 29, 35, 39; Immigration Regulations regs. 44, 48, 60, Schedule 7
sources.said: (2) An application for a Work Permit, except a Freelancer’s work permit and temporary work permit, may be made to the Board in the prescribed form. … (a) the employer has provided the Board with— (i) details of the job description and salary package; … (f) the person in respect of whom the work permit is sought is proficient in written and spoken English; … (2) The application shall be lodged by the employer on behalf of the person he is employing. … (5) An application under this regulation shall be processed after completion of the labour clearance process and the Labour Clearance has been issued under regulation 53. … (a) in respect of a skilled worker, for such period not exceeding five years as the Board may determine; or (b) in respect of an unskilled worker, for such period not exceeding three years, as the Board may determine. (3) A Work Permit issued under this regulation may be extended or renewed. … Work Permits Non-refundable administrative fee $150 (Non-refundable annual fee) … Entertainer/Comedian 2,700 … Fast Track 7 days service $500 each plus $150 administrative Fee … Temporary Work Permit – Regular $750 Extension Temporary Work Permit - Regular Free Fee per Band Member for groups perming at commercial events $250 … (b) is coming to the Islands for up to ten calendar days for the purpose of engaging in gainful occupation or other commercial activity … the Commissioner may extend a temporary work permit for such period not exceeding forty-two days from the date of first issue as he considers appropriate.

note: The Board issues the Work Permit (Employed Person); for an engagement of up to ten days the Commissioner issues a Temporary Work Permit (Ordinance s. 39), extendable to 42 days from first issue, USD 750. The regulations cap a work permit at five years for a skilled worker and three for an unskilled one; which an entertainer counts as isn't stated, so the five-year ceiling is held as the most at once. The fee schedule is the revised edition as at 31 March 2021; a later amendment to Schedule 7 wasn't reached.
